title: Hook Native Event Mapping Tests
description: Test every native hook event mapping using real data from 📜 logs, refactor log format to input/event/response
summary: Refactored hook log format from {context,result} to {input,event,response}. Added HookLogEvent, HookLogResponse types, extractTimestampFromInput. Added TestNativeHookEventMappingWithRealData (85 subtests for all native events across copilot/cursor/windsurf/claude/droid/codex/antigravity with real data from log files). Added TestNativeHookEventMappingFromRealLogFiles (reads real log files for end-to-end validation). All tests pass.
